mcqs.question: Which award was conferred on Andhra Pradesh at the Global Travel Market (GTM) Tourism Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh received the Best Tourism Promotion State award at the GTM Tourism Awards 2026. The award was not for heritage conservation, adventure tourism or eco-tourism.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Andhra Pradesh tourism:

List-I
 a. MoUs and investment
 b. Coastline
 c. Spiritual circuit
 d. Festivals

List-II
 i. 1,053 km
 ii. 100+ MoUs in 18 months and investment of ₹20,000 crore+
 iii. Tirumala, Srisailam, Vijayawada and Arasavalli
 iv. Araku Utsav, Flamingo Festival and Kondaveedu Utsav

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-i, c-iii and d-iv. Andhra Pradesh reported 100+ MoUs and investment of ₹20,000 crore+, has a 1,053 km coastline, the listed spiritual circuit, and the three listed festivals.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The “Holiday in Andhra Pradesh” programme promotes international tourism and destination weddings.
Statement B: The ceremony venue cited for the programme is Kovalam.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. The programme promotes domestic tourism and destination weddings, while the cited ceremony venue is Thiruvananthapuram; Kovalam is mentioned as being in Thiruvananthapuram district.

mcqs.question: According to the CA360 account, on which date was the “Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor” doorstep healthcare programme launched?
mcqs.explanation: CA360 dates the launch of “Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor” to 7 May 2026. The 8 May date is associated with World Red Cross Day and World Thalassemia Day, creating the principal trap.

mcqs.question:
Which one of the following statements regarding the coverage of the “Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor” programme is correct?

1. It covers 5 lakh poor families.
2. It is planned for 3 months.
3. It covers inaccessible areas of 6 districts.
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: the programme covers 5 lakh poor families. It is planned for over 3 years and covers inaccessible areas of 7 districts, not 3 months or 6 districts.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly lists the districts associated with the Red Cross awards mentioned in Andhra Pradesh?
options: SPSR Nellore, West Godavari, Bapatla, Krishna and Kakinada
SPSR Nellore, East Godavari, Bapatla, Krishna and Kakinada
West Godavari, Bapatla, Krishna, Kakinada and Kadapa
SPSR Nellore, West Godavari, Guntur, Krishna and Kakinada
mcqs.explanation: The districts are SPSR Nellore, West Godavari, Bapatla, Krishna and Kakinada. East Godavari, Kadapa and Guntur are substitutions and therefore do not form the stated list.

mcqs.question: What is the expansion of C-SAFE, the Andhra Pradesh programme aimed at reducing unnecessary Caesarean sections?
options: Comprehensive Surgical Framework for Emergency Care
Clinical Standards for Antenatal and Family Emergencies
mcqs.explanation: C-SAFE stands for Caesarean Section – Safety and Appropriateness. The other expansions are not the stated meaning of the programme.

mcqs.question: Which group comprises the partners of the AP C-SAFE programme?
options: University of Liverpool, University of Birmingham, Fernandez Foundation and UNICEF
University of Liverpool, University of Birmingham, Red Cross Society and UNICEF
University of Liverpool, Fernandez Foundation, WHO and UNICEF
University of Birmingham, Fernandez Foundation, Red Cross Society and UNICEF
mcqs.explanation: The partners are the University of Liverpool, University of Birmingham, Fernandez Foundation and UNICEF. The Red Cross Society and WHO are substitutions in the other options.

mcqs.question:
Which one of the following statements regarding the outcomes reported under AP C-SAFE is correct?

1. At Machilipatnam Government Hospital, normal deliveries increased from 23% to 34%.
2. At Machilipatnam Government Hospital, C-sections increased from 66% to 77%.
3. At Eluru Government Hospital, post-caesarean infections fell from 31% to 62%.
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: normal deliveries at Machilipatnam Government Hospital rose from 23% to 34%. C-sections fell from 77% to 66%, and post-caesarean infections at Eluru fell from 62% to 31%, so statements 2 and 3 reverse the figures.

mcqs.question: Which school in Andhra Pradesh is being developed as an international school under the Andhra Model of Education?
mcqs.explanation: Nidamarru school in Mangalagiri is being developed as an international school, with one model school planned per district. Kadapa is associated with the start of smart kitchens, not this international-school initiative.
